user_goal: Find via quantitative calculations which candidate mechanism could yield an operational influence of genuinely later independently generated choice on already committed earlier result

mathematical_results.experiment: 011A-1 standard Born-rule Bell state with Bob later choosing Z or X
mathematical_results.mechanism: Standard trace-preserving quantum operations, no signalling; conditioning on future Bob measurement gives a distinct earlier-looking ensemble, no early-readable signal

mathematical_results.interpretation: A large apparent retrocorrelation requires future success selection; without early success flag it cannot change the independent full earlier record.

mathematical_results.experiment: 011A-3 ontological retrocausal hidden lambda model TOY
mathematical_results.interpretation: An ontological model can explicitly contain future-dependent hidden states yet be operationally indistinguishable from no-signalling QM.

mathematical_results.experiment: 011A-4 ordinary classical shared past cause false-retro model
mathematical_results.interpretation: Measurement-setting non-independence can imitate a strong later-past correlation. Authentic physical independent do(C) is the crucial experimental discriminator.

mathematical_results.experiment: 011A-5 genuinely later independent physical intervention power planning
mathematical_results.null: P(A+|do(C=0)) equals P(A+|do(C=1)) for all precommitted early A records
mathematical_results.sample_size_model: Balanced independent Bernoulli source with p approx 1/2; Gaussian approximation, no extra looks or multiplicity, no setting leakage, no source loss
mathematical_results.interpretation: Numerically targets a falsifiable conditional dependence with physically after-A C, not a prediction that such dependence exists.

candidate_priority.observable_operational_detection_target: Independently witnessed early A with full trial inclusion, genuinely generated later physically independent do(C), externally calibrated order and all propagation delays, nonzero P(A|do(C)) reproducible in fresh laboratories
candidate_priority.indistinguishable_ontological_models: Cannot be localized by A,C statistics alone; require additional independently testable postulates
candidate_priority.postselection_PCTC_and_quantum_eraser: Mathematically tempting but accessible unconditional early outcome unchanged; do not treat selected histories as a backwards communications channel
candidate_priority.quantum_switch_indefinite_causal_order: Interesting distinct causal-structure research but causal nonseparability does not itself establish information travelling into prior local records
candidate_priority.critical_negative_control: Earlier shared variable U causing both A and C, even where physical C appears later

scientific_notes.project_result: Mathematically specified search location and falsifiable effect-size requirements, not detection of real retrocausality
